name: Aino
title: Clinky-Clank Gadgets-A-Gogo
description: A genius mechanic and inventor from Nod-Krai who loves interesting machines and sweet treats.

skills.name: Bish-Bash-Bosh Repair
skills.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 3 consecutive strikes.

Charged Attack
Drains Stamina over time to perform continuous spinning attacks against all nearby opponents.
At the end of the sequence, performs a more powerful slash.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

skills.name: Musecatcher
skills.description:
Aino throws a Musecatcher forward, dealing Hydro DMG and dragging her along behind it. When the dragging stops, Aino deals AoE Hydro DMG to nearby opponents.
Holding the Skill will cause it to behave differently.

Hold
Enter Aiming Mode to adjust the Musecatcher's throwing direction.

skills.name: Precision Hydronic Cooler
skills.description:
Aino deploys a custom water-spraying device, the Cool Your Jets Ducky to establish a Focused Hydronic Cooling Zone.
While active, the Cool Your Jets Ducky will periodically fire water balls at nearby opponents, dealing Hydro DMG.

passives.name: Modular Efficiency Protocol
passives.description:
Aino will be granted the corresponding buff effects based on the party's Moonsign.

Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: Her Elemental Burst Precision Hydronic Cooler is enhanced: The Cool Your Jets Ducky will fire water balls more frequently, and the water balls will deal AoE Hydro DMG over a larger area of effect.

passives.name: Structured Power Booster
passives.description: Aino's Elemental Burst DMG is increased by 50% of her Elemental Mastery.

passives.name: Moonsign Benediction: Force Limit Analysis
passives.description: When Aino is in the party, the party's Moonsign will increase by 1 level.

passives.name: Miniaturized Detection Sensor
passives.description:
Displays the location of nearby resources unique to Nod-Krai on the mini-map.
Additionally, Aino appears to be able to alter the Cool Your Jets Ducky's appearance in some way...

constellations.name: The Theory of Ash—Field Equilibrium
constellations.description:
After Aino uses her Elemental Skill Musecatcher or her Elemental Burst Precision Hydronic Cooler, her Elemental Mastery will be increased by 80. The Elemental Mastery of other nearby active party members will be increased by 80 for 15s.

The Elemental Mastery-increasing effects of this Constellation do not stack.

constellations.name: The Principle of Transference in Gear Differentials
constellations.description: If Aino is off-field while the Focused Hydronic Cooling Zone of her Elemental Burst Precision Hydronic Cooler is active, when your active party member hits a nearby opponent with an attack, the Cool Your Jets Ducky will fire an additional water ball at that opponent, dealing AoE Hydro DMG equal to 25% of Aino's ATK and 100% of her Elemental Mastery. This DMG is considered Elemental Burst DMG. This effect can be triggered once every 5s.

constellations.name: Cake and the Art of Mechanism Repair
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Precision Hydronic Cooler by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Butter and Cats and the Law of Energy Supply
constellations.description: When the Elemental Skill Musecatcher hits an opponent, it will restore 10 Elemental Energy for Aino. Energy can be restored to her in this manner once every 10s.

constellations.name: Perpetual Turbine of Metal and Light
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Musecatcher by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: The Burden of Creative Genius
constellations.description:
For the next 15s after using the Elemental Burst Precision Hydronic Cooler, DMG from nearby active characters' Electro-Charged, Bloom, Lunar-Charged, Lunar-Bloom, and Lunar-Crystallize reactions is increased by 15%.
Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: DMG from the aforementioned reactions will be further increased by 20%.

outfits.name: Fluffy Puffy Whiz-Kid Workwear
outfits.description: Aino's outfit. The oversized white coat looks especially baggy on her petite frame, and the wide sleeves seem perfect for stashing mysterious treasures. Give them a shake and... who knows what might pop out?

voices.title: Hello
voices.text: Oh! Are you here to play with me? Hee-hee, my name's Aino, and I'm an inventor! Me and Ineffa live together. I could probably eat all the cakes and cookies in the world, because I love them sooo much. But my favorite kind of all is Lakkaberry Krumkake! Come visit my Clink-Clank Krumkake Craftshop whenever you want! Anyway, that's me — what about you? Tell me something about you, then we'll be friends!

voices.title: Chat: Plans
voices.text: It's been way too long since I last had some candy. My brain's grinding to a halt, like a rusty machine... That's it! I'm having five whole Krumkakes for dinner tonight, and nothing's gonna stop me. Not even Ineffa's super-angry mode!

voices.title: Chat: Toothache
voices.text: *grimace* I just got a really bad toothache... Whyyy? Ineffa, help me! *whimper*

voices.title: Chat: Play
voices.text: Don't worry, I put Ineffa in charge of all my work for today, so we can go play with Knuckle Duckle!

voices.title: When It Rains
voices.text: Achoo! *sniff* ...Ugh, my shoes and socks are soaking wet. I wanna go home...

voices.title: After the Rain
voices.text: Oh, the rain's stopped! Let's go on a trip. And let's bring Ineffa!

voices.title: When It Snows
voices.text: Wahoo, it's snowing! Here, you can have my Boo-Hoo Snowball Maker. It makes a crying sound when you make a snowball with it. Fun, right? ...Me? Oh, I'll use this Tee-Hee Snowball Maker instead. Anyway — c'mon, let's have a snowball fight!

voices.title: When the Sun Is Out
voices.text: Whew, the sun is so bright... Take my sleeve, it'll help keep the sun out of your eyes. ...Oh... Um, can you stoop down a little? I'm on my tippie toes, but I can't quite reach...

voices.title: In the Desert
voices.text: Wait... I think I hear machine noises in the distance. C'mon, c'mon, let's go check it out~ Something tells me there's a boatload of spare parts waiting to be collected, hehehe...

voices.title: Good Morning
voices.text: I got Ineffa to make breakfast for you! It's a selection of mini cakes — they're really sweet and super tasty... Huh, cake crumbs at the corners of my mouth? Those are just, um, uh... *sigh* Alright, I'll tell you the truth, since you're my friend and all. I'm sorry, I went ahead and ate my ones already. ...Hmm? You'll split yours with me? Amazing! In that case, I'll split my... In fact, here — you can have all my fruits and veggies!

voices.title: Good Afternoon
voices.text: Number two screws... Where the heck did I put my number two screws...? Actually... Ineffa! Gimme one of your number two screws. There should be some on your wrists and elbows. ...Ugh, yes, I know lunch is ready, I'll be there in a minute. Come on, be a good girl and hand over that screw~

voices.title: Good Evening
voices.text: Look at these plates I invented! When you give them the order, they come walking over to you. Dinner, come out! Serve me food!

voices.title: Good Night
voices.text: Huh? Y—You're leaving already? ...Wait! Don't you wanna try out my new Glug-Glug Tea Brewer again? Or... we could play another game! Hmm... Okay, fine. Pinky promise. Tomorrow it is, don't forget!

voices.title: About Aino: Pragmatism
voices.text: Everything I build uses parts that I've salvaged from broken-down machines. That's how I rebuilt Ineffa, too. A scrap heap is just useful stuff in the wrong place. It doesn't matter where I get it from — as long as it works, it's as good as new to me.

voices.title: About Aino: Parental Duty
voices.text: When you're the head of a family, you gotta make sure everyone's well looked after. So when Ineffa finishes her chores, I always stroke her head and tell her what a great job she did. Same goes for all my other robots too — I always make sure to compliment them when they finish their work. Ah, I'm such a great parent!

voices.title: About Us: Kerplunk-a-tron
voices.text: Oh, that thing on my back? That's Kerplunk-a-tron, my assistant. Multifunctional to the max! You wanna try it out? Don't worry, he won't bite. Come on, Kerplunk-a-tron, say hello! "Kerplunk, kerplunk!"

voices.title: About Us: Sneaky Food
voices.text: I mean, I do get it... Ineffa only controls my sugar intake out of concern for my health. But I'm not a robot. Sweet stuff is sooo hard to resist! So my solution is: If Ineffa didn't see it, I didn't eat it! C'mon, let's go eat some desserts. My treat — as long as you promise not to tell her~

voices.title: About the Vision
voices.text: When I built Ineffa, I took her apart and put her back together again so many times, 'cause I kept wanting to add more and more functionality... Then, at some point, I went to grab the next component, and suddenly I found that I was holding a Vision. I hadn't slept in a while, so at first, I thought I was seeing things... Hmm? How long did Ineffa take me to build in total? Ahem, it's not about how long or how short it took — the important thing to remember is that Aino is a genius!

voices.title: Something to Share
voices.text: This one's called the Boom and Blast Kuuvahki Energy Cannon. Well, it was at first. But pretty much everyone except Ineffa has ended up calling it "Cannon." *sigh* Never mind, it's a functional machine, and I can understand why people can't be bothered trying to say the full name in the heat of the moment. As long as people think it's a useful invention, I won't insist on a cute-sounding name.

voices.title: Interesting Things
voices.text: You might not believe this, but in the time it takes you to count to a hundred, I could take apart a whole crab... and by the time you get to two hundred, I could put it back together again, good as new. Hehe, dismantling machines isn't that different from dismantling crabs.

voices.title: About Ineffa: Warmth
voices.text: I've made a bunch of upgrades to Ineffa since she first woke up. Like when I added that body temperature simulator, 'cause when you hold someone's hand or give them a hug, it's supposed to feel warm and fuzzy! You know what I mean? The next time Ineffa's here, let's both give her a big hug at the same time!

voices.title: About Ineffa: Family
voices.text: Ineffa is the most important person in my family. I'm so, so thankful for your help — not just for getting her back home safe and sound, but for helping fix her little memory problem, too. Actually, why don't you come 'round to my place right now? I'll get Ineffa to make Krumkake for you... No, wait — I'll make them myself! And, and I can make Midsommar Torte too. It's really good, have you tried it? ...Hmm? Why are you running away? I wasn't finished!

voices.title: About Jahoda
voices.text: Jahoda might bicker a lot with Ineffa, but they're actually really close. She was the first friend that Ineffa made. I'm not a controlling parent, so I don't tell Ineffa who she can and can't make friends with. Some friends just argue more than others — somehow, fighting it out brings them closer together. Oh, I almost forgot to mention, you know her robotic arm? It's pretty, right? I was the one who built that, although it's my student who handles the maintenance and repairs these days.

voices.title: About Lauma
voices.text: You like her antlers? I could make you a pair just like them. Oh, and how about I make them glow and grow flowers? Or maybe shoot fireworks? It'd be a piece of cake for me. ...The Frostmoon Scions wouldn't take kindly to that? Okay fine, then I'll make some for them, too.

voices.title: About Flins
voices.text: Ah, what a fine young gentleman he is. His speech is music to my ears, like the beautiful clink-clank of moving machinery. ...Too far? Well, yeah, it's pretty high praise, I guess... But it's also the truth! And no, I'm not biased because I've been bribed with cakes!

voices.title: About Dori
voices.text: She came to discuss a potential business partnership with me once. Hehehe, can't blame her for trying her luck... but she was just too stingy. As Ineffa put it, the amount I'd earn in one day of working for Dori wouldn't even cover the cost of two freshly baked Fruit Tandem Turnovers. Genius only works on a full stomach, y'know! *sigh* If only she was open to letting me dismantle those strange and exotic machines she owns. Maybe then we could come to an arrangement...

voices.title: About Nefer
voices.text: Nefer has a black cat called Ashru. I offered to install a translator so we could understand what Ashru is saying, but Nefer turned me down without even considering it. She said she already has plenty of information and doesn't need to hear what a cat has to say. Like, what!? Why so mean? Has she been hurt before, maybe by Lauma's translations?

voices.title: About Varka
voices.text: Varka kept me company a lot while Ineffa was away looking for you guys. Sometimes, when he noticed that I was missing Ineffa, he'd come and pat me on the head and make me feel better. He has really big, heavy hands, and they're covered in calluses... But they still feel really warm.

voices.title: About Linnea
voices.text: Ooh, Linnea? I really like her! When I was little, she used to tell us loads of cool stories whenever she got back from one of her trips. When I was a bit older, and I'd learned how to build robots, I wanted to give her one as a gift... but she never accepted any of them. She said it was the thought that counts, and that was enough for her — but I think it was because none of them were her style. So, I'm gonna keep making robots until she finds one she likes. I know I'll get there eventually!

voices.title: About Prune
voices.text: I'm always so happy to see her! Every time she comes to play, she gives me desserts that Ineffa gives her — as long as Ineffa doesn't notice, I get to eat twice as much! *sigh* Will Prune come back to visit now she lives in Mondstadt? There aren't many friends who really listen when I talk about machines...

voices.title: More About Aino: I
voices.text: You wanna hear more about me? Yeah, of course! Let's trade: I'll tell you something about me, and you tell me one of your stories! Deal?

voices.title: More About Aino: II
voices.text: I have no problem at all with clients on a tight budget. Even five thousand Mora can go a long way. It's the people who don't appreciate my work who are the real problem. I add all sorts of fun functionality into their robots, and then they go and complain that it isn't "practical." There's no helping some people.

voices.title: More About Aino: III
voices.text: Papa Wrench? Where'd you hear about him? He's my teacher, and he doesn't even know his own name anymore, but he still remembers all the specs when it comes to machine parts. I tell him all my ideas, even for my craziest projects. He always smiles back, rubs my head, and says "Aino, that's a wonderful idea! I can't wait to see the finished product."

voices.title: More About Aino: IV
voices.text: The first robot I ever built was called Clink-Clank. It was totally different from the kind of things I build nowadays. No so-called "practical" functions, it couldn't talk, it couldn't do housework... bet you can't imagine that, huh? Anyway, it kept me company for the longest time, but eventually it got to the point where the outer casing was completely busted up, and all the bolts were falling out and wouldn't go back in, so I had to take it out of service.

voices.title: More About Aino: V
voices.text: The real reason I chose to build robots rather than invent other things was because... well, I just wanted someone to play with. People always have stuff they need to do, I get that. They can only hang out with me for a little while before I'm all on my own again, but my robots will always be there for me. Then one day, Ineffa told me that she saw me as family, and that I could trust her... I burst out crying when she said that, because I know that robots don't tell lies...

voices.title: Aino's Hobbies
voices.text: I like giving robots functions that other people would never think of. I mean, think about it, how much more fun is a vacuum bot when you can take it out for walkies like a pet doggy?

voices.title: Aino's Troubles
voices.text: Why is it that I can never find the part I need when I need it, and then it shows up randomly when I don't need it? I can't exactly go installing an auto-locator on every single component, now can I? ...Try magnets? *sigh* No, that'd mess with all the sensitive instruments around here. Plus, Ineffa would get stuck...

voices.title: Favorite Food
voices.text: If I ever somehow turn into a robot, promise me you'll make sugar my energy source! A day without sugar would be like... well, the most bitter day in your life, by definition. I wouldn't make it till nightfall.

voices.title: Least Favorite Food
voices.text: There's this kind of flatbread in Nod-Krai that's hard as rock. Ever tried it? It's like biting down on Ineffa's outer shell! And worst of all, it's not even sweet! Unforgivable!

voices.title: Receiving a Gift: I
voices.text: Wow! This is sooo good! I'm gonna get Ineffa to scrap all the snacks in next week's menu and replace them with this! And the week after that, too! You got any more? Just one more, pleeease? C'mon, one more can't hurt!

voices.title: Receiving a Gift: II
voices.text: It's pretty good, but it's missing that happy flavor. Oh, I got it — take this sachet of sugar! Next time, add it in. I'm telling you, it'll take the flavor to the next level!

voices.title: Receiving a Gift: III
voices.text: Hmm, this tastes kinda bland... Why don't you let me cook this time? Huh? No? Okay then... Well, at least let me give you my spare krumkake maker. Hold on a minute, I'll remodel it so it can cook other stuff too!

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Looks like someone's waiting for an Aino surprise... Tada! Hehe, it's the Spinny Chanty Wishing Lantern! When you light the candle, it sings happy birthday and spins around. Isn't it fun? If you like it, then you have to play with me next year too! Oh, uh, now you gotta make a wish, and you gotta say it out loud so I can hear it! Whatever you wish for, Aino the genius can make it come true!

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Intro
voices.text: Ooh, is this what robots feel like when they get an upgrade?

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Building Up
voices.text: Upgrade complete. Aino operational stability increased... energy consumption also increased... please feed Aino sufficient cakes.

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Climax
voices.text: I can tell you really appreciate true genius. Hehehe, you have chosen wisely!

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Conclusion
voices.text: I think my perfect family would be someone like you... someone that understands me, supports me, and spends time with me... No, I don't feel sad. From now on, you can always trust me, okay? After all, there's no problem that Aino the genius parent can't solve!

voices.title: Elemental Skill: I
voices.text: Chew on this!

voices.title: Elemental Skill: II
voices.text: Kerplunk!

voices.title: Elemental Skill: III
voices.text: Go claw!

voices.title: Elemental Skill: IV
voices.text: Eeny, meeny, miny, moe...

voices.title: Elemental Skill: V
voices.text: Ready!

voices.title: Elemental Skill: VI
voices.text: Mwuhaha!

voices.title: Elemental Burst: I
voices.text: Look, a rainbow!

voices.title: Elemental Burst: II
voices.text: Ding-dong, waterbomb!

voices.title: Elemental Burst: III
voices.text: Splash attack!

voices.title: Opening Treasure Chest: I
voices.text: Let me see, anything I can salvage?

voices.title: Opening Treasure Chest: II
voices.text: Wow, so much stuff... If only Ineffa was here.

voices.title: Opening Treasure Chest: III
voices.text: Whoa! Ah, what a mess... I'm sorry, it wasn't on purpose.

voices.title: Low HP: I
voices.text: Why isn't it working?

voices.title: Low HP: II
voices.text: Play nice!

voices.title: Low HP: III
voices.text: Cheater!

voices.title: Ally at Low HP: I
voices.text: Alright, you've had your fun!

voices.title: Ally at Low HP: II
voices.text: Don't worry, Aino can fix it!

voices.title: Fallen: I
voices.text: Looks like... playtime's over...

voices.title: Fallen: II
voices.text: Ineffa, I'm cold...

voices.title: Fallen: III
voices.text: I want... a krumkake...

voices.title: Light Hit Taken: I
voices.text: Meanie!

voices.title: Heavy Hit Taken: I
voices.text: Ahh! Whoops...

voices.title: Heavy Hit Taken: II
voices.text: Ouch...

voices.title: Joining Party: I
voices.text: Yay, playtime!

voices.title: Joining Party: II
voices.text: Lemme down, kerplunk-a-tron!

voices.title: Joining Party: III
voices.text: Aino? Present!
